A '''planet''' was home to a colony of [[fenti bean]] and [[Nerf/Legends|nerf]] farmers. A [[Unidentified carnivorous plant|carnivorous plant]] grew in a ravine on the world. The colony was once visited by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ortraag]] and [[Jedi Watchman/Legends|Jedi Watchman]] [[Shalavaa]].
